passage:
Fran and Brad are in a band. 
“I quit,” said Brad. 
Brad grabs his bag. 
He slams it into the van. 
Fran can see Brad is mad.

Fran and Brad get in the van. 
“You are mad,” said Fran. 
Brad hits his bag. 
“Yes! I am mad,” said Brad. 
Fran grabs his hand. 
“Let’s rest a bit.”

Brad grins. 
“Yes. Let’s rest.” 
Brad and Fran rest a bit. 
“I am not mad,” said Brad, “I do not quit.”
“I am glad,” said Fran.
